title: What a static bot gets wrong, and what time-aware designs did
source: Advisor briefs and self improving harnesses.md (section 'These numbers separate a static bot from a learning one')
note: Published benchmarks, not Pregame's own numbers. A time-aware design beating a naive one is a different claim from a self-improving loop beating its own previous version.

rows.static: Memory systems missed 37.48-94.25% of updates (HaluMem-Medium); wrong updates stayed at or below 1.15%
rows.designed: Extract evidence, then apply newest-wins in code: conflict resolution 54% -> 82-93%
rows.caveat: Benchmark hosted by the maker of the top system; the design result is a preprint

rows.static: Retrieval served superseded values 15-40% of the time
Agents followed a withdrawn constraint in 77.3% of episodes
rows.designed: One verification slot on the constraint's source: +61 to +89 points
rows.caveat: Single-author preprint; 16 LLMs, not memory products

rows.static: Best memory system 50.4%; with oracle evidence 68.7% (SubtleMemory)

rows.failure: Keeping the old fact next to the new
rows.static: Outdated information 'leads to at least 20% performance drop' even when the current fact is retrieved (HoH)
rows.caveat: Quote the sentence; the metric is unclear

rows.designed: A versioned store recovered 100%; stale answers 19.4% -> 10.9% (MoM)
rows.caveat: The stale-answer baseline is the authors' own system

rows.static: 35-49% of personalised claims were over-inferred (Personalization Mirage)
rows.designed: Beliefs stored with probabilities nearly doubled the correction rate (BeliefMem)

rows.static: 13% of quotes altered or not in the source (BBC study)
rows.designed: 0 errors inside quoted text when code inserts it (deterministic quoting)
rows.caveat: By construction; the pilot had N = 60 and is a self-report

rows.static: Frontier models add it to 7-13% of summaries (Vectara leaderboard)
rows.caveat: Judged by the HHEM model, not humans

self_improvement: On unseen tests, published self-improving systems with a proper test gate gain about 2-10 points; independent re-tests find +1 to +3, and about one setting in four gets worse. Only Pregame's own results on unseen test meetings can show its loop works.
